channel.title: B-Acoustics Guides — Acoustic Engineering & Soundproofing, Singapore
channel.description: Resource and compliance guides on soundproofing, acoustic ratings, and Singapore noise regulations — written from projects we've actually scoped, not generic advice.

item.title: Noisy Neighbours in Singapore: Mediation, Enforcement, and the Acoustic Fix
item.description: Singapore's Community Disputes Resolution Act can compel mediation and issue abatement orders for neighbour noise. Here's how that process works, and where soundproofing actually fits alongside it.

item.title: What Drives Home Theatre Soundproofing Cost in Singapore
item.description: Home theatre soundproofing cost depends on the STC target, wall construction, and whether low-frequency bass is isolated — not floor area alone. Here's what actually sets the price.

item.title: HDB vs Condo Soundproofing Rules in Singapore
item.description: HDB and condo soundproofing projects follow different approval processes in Singapore — permit timing and noise-hour rules for HDB, MCST approval for condos. Here's what actually differs.

item.title: NEA Boundary Noise Limits in Singapore, Explained
item.description: The real NEA boundary noise limits for factory premises in Singapore — dB(A) limits by premises type and time of day, how compliance is assessed, and what to do if you're over the limit.

item.title: STC vs NRC: Which Acoustic Rating Matters for Your Space?
item.description: STC and NRC are the two acoustic ratings most often confused. Here's what each one actually measures, and how to know which one your project needs.

item.title: What Actually Drives the Cost of Office Soundproofing
item.description: Every fit-out enquiry starts with the same question: how much will this cost? The honest answer is that office soundproofing is priced on a handful of variables, not a flat rate per square metre.
